characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike oranž orav, kellel on kohev punakaspruun saba, valge kõht, ühevärviline kollane kootud kampsun ilma mustrita ja suured rõõmsad silmad. Peas pole mütsi. Armas ja sõbralik multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASSI
characters.description: Väike siil, kellel on seljas palju teravaid hallikaspruune okkaid, terav ninake, väikesed ümarad kõrvad ja ühevärviline roheline kootud kampsun. Armas ja sõbralik multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: A cheerful sunny autumn garden with yellow and orange maple trees, green grass scattered with colorful fallen leaves, a cozy low wooden fence in the background, and a clean rainwater puddle on a dirt path in the center. Warm sunlight. Clean simple cartoon style.

pages.text: ORAV OTT JA SIIL SASSI MÄNGIVAD AIAS.
pages.scene: Orav Ott (a cute orange squirrel wearing a plain yellow sweater with no letters) and Siil Sassi (a cute hedgehog wearing a plain green sweater with no letters) are standing together in a sunny autumn garden, surrounded by green grass and colorful falling autumn leaves. Both characters are smiling happily. Landscape view, cheerful cartoon style. Orav Ott is a small orange squirrel with a bushy reddish-brown tail (never pink), wearing a plain yellow knitted sweater with no stars or pattern and no hat. Siil Sassi is a small hedgehog: round body covered in spiky grey-brown quills, a small pointed snout with a black nose, small round ears; he is NOT an elephant or a pig and has no trunk and no big ears. He wears a plain green knitted sweater. The grass and garden path fill the picture down to the bottom edge.

Orav Ott and Siil Sassi stand near a big clear rainwater puddle on a dirt path in the autumn garden. They look at the puddle with excitement and wonder, pointing at the water. Golden tree leaves frame the top of the scene. Orav Ott is a small orange squirrel with a bushy reddish-brown tail (never pink), wearing a plain yellow knitted sweater with no stars or pattern and no hat. Siil Sassi is a small hedgehog: round body covered in spiky grey-brown quills, a small pointed snout with a black nose, small round ears; he is NOT an elephant or a pig and has no trunk and no big ears. He wears a plain green knitted sweater. The grass and garden path fill the picture down to the bottom edge. There is no plain colored stripe or band at the bottom; the grass, leaves and path continue right to the bottom edge of the picture.

Orav Ott kneels on the grass and holds up a flat, thin, smooth piece of brown tree bark (not a log), showing it proudly to Siil Sassi. Siil Sassi stands beside him, smiling with delight. Autumn leaves scatter the green ground around them. Siil Sassi carefully sticks a bright yellow maple leaf onto a flat, thin piece of brown bark to make a sail, while Orav Ott holds the flat bark steady on the ground. There is no log and no finished boat yet, only the flat bark and the leaf. There is no log anywhere in the picture. Both characters look proud and overjoyed.
